name: Scary Larry
bio: Lives under the stairs of every map. Comes out for the scoreboard.
notes: The owner's own Meshy model, made and rigged in Meshy (Drive folder, 2026-11-01: "scary larry rigged", the All Animations GLB; its two clips are not used). Its rig names its joints the Mixamo way (mixamorig:Hips ...), read as Meshy's. A grinning man in a cap, tactical vest and camouflage shorts.
